Allmans View, Coolfadda

Co. Cork

Applications Closed

  • Starting From

    €1,080

  • Location

    Bandon, Co. Cork

  • Bedrooms

    2 & 3 Bed

  • Availability

    20 Units

Allmans View is in a superb location on Convent Hill and is situated in a picturesque location with views over the River Bandon valley. The houses are within walking distance of the picturesque town of Bandon and 30 minutes commute of Cork City. Local amenities are just a few minutes drive with a choice of schools along with sporting and leisure facilities.

More details are available on Cork County Council's site.
